Stratified Partitioning of Multi-Cohort Data

Source: R/data_partitioning.R
dot-stratified_partition_cohorts.Rd

Partitions each cohort's data into train, validation, and held-out sets while maintaining class balance within each partition.

.stratified_partition_cohorts(x_list, y_list, train_ratio, val_ratio)

Arguments

x_list

List of feature matrices (one per cohort).

y_list

List of binary response factors (one per cohort).

train_ratio

Proportion of data for training.

val_ratio

Proportion of data for validation.

Value

List containing:

train_x

List of training matrices (one per cohort)

train_y

List of training response factors

val_x

List of validation matrices

val_y

List of validation response factors

heldout_x

List of held-out matrices

heldout_y

List of held-out response factors

cohort_names

Character vector of cohort names

partition_info

Data frame with partition sizes per cohort
